text:
Elena (Design): dropping a fresh prototype for the credentials page. main goals: reduce panic during rotate, make soft-revoke discoverable, improve clipboard behavior. mock: https://redwood/drive/cred-proto-v3.png. thoughts?
Jorge (PM): love the focus on reducing panic. two quick asks: surface scope during create (so ppl pick embedding-only by default) and make the revoke path recoverable for 24h.
Sam (Engineering): we can do soft-revoke (deactivate flag + ttl) and show re-enable within 24h. note: we only ever return full secret at creation time; after that it's masked `••••••1234`.
Elena (Design): UI idea: after create show a transient inline drawer with the plaintext key + a big CTA "Save this key now" and a small checkbox "I stored it" before dismiss. also a tiny copy button that writes to clipboard.
Priya (A11y): a11y: the transient drawer must receive focus and be dismissible with ESC. the copy button should announce `Copied API key to clipboard` via a live region. avoid relying only on color to convey warnings.
Nikhil (Backend): clipboard write is browser-side. we should emit telemetry `console_key_copied` when copy is clicked so we can measure drop-off. also rate-limit copy attempts to mitigate brute force scripts.
Maya (Support): suggestion: include a short helper message in the drawer: "If you lose this key, you can soft-revoke to stop traffic and reissue within 24h." would reduce tickets about accidental deletes.
Sam (Engineering): rotate flow: two patterns we considered: A) block rotate until user confirms replacement key stored B) allow rotate and show checklist + dependency estimate. We can implement B quickly; A requires extra persistence and UX work.
Elena (Design): in the mock I went with B: rotate modal with a checklist and a non-blocking checkbox "I have updated dependent services". For high-scope keys (admin) the checkbox becomes required.
Jorge (PM): good. also add a dependency estimate: "Potentially impacted services: ~3 (based on last 30 days)" with an action `Run full scan`.
Priya (A11y): ensure the scan action indicates progress (aria-busy) and that the estimate is described: `aria-describedby` linking to explanation text.
Sam (Engineering): backend can return a best-effort estimate. label it as estimate. deep scan will be async and send notification when complete.
Elena (Design): soft-revoke banner copy proposals: Option 1: "Deactivated  Can be reactivated within 24 hours." Option 2: "Temporarily deactivated  Reactivate within 24h." Which feels clearer?
Maya (Support): Option 2 reads clearer to customers. "Temporarily deactivated" sets expectation it's not permanent.
Priya (A11y): banner color needs good contrast. also include a focusable `Reactivate` button in the banner, with clear aria-label `Reactivate API key temporarily deactivated, expires in 24 hours`.
Nikhil (Backend): we'll expose `deactivated_until` timestamp so the UI can show countdown. reactivate should call a specific endpoint that checks TTL.
Jorge (PM): telemetry asks: tag events with `created_from=console|api`, `action_source=drawer|table|modal`, and `scope` so we can segment.
Elena (Design): table UX: rows show name, scope badge, last used, and an overflow menu. I added a tiny inline `reveal` icon that appears for 10s after creation. Sam: ok to show reveal only in newly-created rows?
Sam (Engineering): yes, we can flag `recently_created=true` for the row and only render the reveal affordance then. after 10s, switch to masked.
Priya (A11y): note: don't rely on hover-only interactions. the reveal control must be keyboard-focusable and announce `Full key available for 10 seconds`.
Elena (Design): copy for rotate primary action: `Rotate and reveal new key`. Priya recommended avoiding `copy` verb. Jorge: prefer `Rotate and reveal`. Any objections?
Priya (A11y): `Rotate and reveal` is fine. add small subtext under the button: `New key shown only once; save it now.` Also add a confirmation checkbox when scope includes admin.
Sam (Engineering): one more: add server-side audit log entry `api_key_rotated` with actor, old_key_id, new_key_id, and `rotation_mode` (immediate|grace-period).
Maya (Support): for support traps, when user chooses grace-period rotation, include an optional free-text "Transition notes" that gets stored in the audit log. can help troubleshooting.
Elena (Design): accessibility nit: ensure the destructive warning uses both icon + text and isn't pure red-on-white for colorblindness. include `role=alert` for screen reader emphasis.
Jorge (PM): ok next steps: Elena to update mocks with drawer flow and soft-revoke banner; Sam/Nikhil to spec endpoints (`/keys/:id/soft_revoke`, `/keys/:id/reactivate`, `/keys/:id/rotate?mode=grace`). Priya to provide color tokens that meet AA for banners and warning pills. Maya to draft a small support blurb.
console-bot: Reminder: design sync at 3pm — add updated mocks to the doc before the meeting. :spiral_calendar:
Elena (Design): will post updated mock in ~90m and tag this thread. thanks everyone :heart:
extra_notes: design review focused on reducing friction during key rotation and making revoke recoverable. emphasized A11y and telemetry.
